name: public-megascale-proteingym-sequence-evolution-structure
hypothesis: Sequence/evolution averaging improved PR-AUC on 49 of 63 discovery stability-assay proteins. Add ESM-IF1 inverse-folding likelihood because compatibility with the folded backbone is directly relevant to proteolysis-based stability. Its discovery correlation with ESM2 is only 0.079. Use an equal normalized three-term mean, retaining all frozen ranges; do not treat overlap with ProteinGym as independent evidence.
